title: GitHub - hcsum/dont-let-me: Turn your agent into a mentor. It knows what you're working toward, and how you get in your own way.
excerpt: Turn your agent into a mentor. It knows what you're working toward, and how you get in your own way. - hcsum/dont-let-me
content_html:
Turn your agent into a mentor. It knows what you're working toward, and how you get in your own way.

Install

Claude Code 
claude plugin marketplace add hcsum/dont-let-me
claude plugin install mentor@dont-let-me

Then run /mentor:init to set up your profile, and /mentor:check any time you want the alignment check on demand.

Codex 
codex plugin marketplace add hcsum/dont-let-me --ref main
codex plugin add mentor@dont-let-me

Then run $mentor-init to set up your profile, and $mentor-check any time you want the alignment check on demand.

Codex makes you trust a hook before it runs: open /hooks, review the SessionStart entry, trust it. Until you do, the profile never loads.

OpenCode

OpenCode has no plugin marketplace for this, so clone it and point the config at the two pieces:

git clone https://github.com/hcsum/dont-let-me.git ~/.mentor/plugin
// ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
{
  "instructions": ["~/.mentor/plugin/stance.md", "~/.mentor/profile.md"],
  "skills": { "paths": ["~/.mentor/plugin/skills"] }
}

Then run /mentor-init to set up your profile, and /mentor-check any time you want the alignment check on demand.

In my own use, Claude Code is where this works best. Codex and OpenCode both run it, but how well the nudges land depends on the model behind them, and I've had better results with Claude.

1. It interviews you

Setup asks you questions, one at a time, for about ten minutes. Run /mentor:init in Claude Code, $mentor-init in Codex, /mentor-init in OpenCode. Two things come out of it.

Your long-term goals. What you're actually working toward. It pushes back if you answer vaguely.

Your anti-patterns. The ways you reliably get in your own way, written down while you're still honest about them, so it can hold you to them later when you're not:

- [ship] don't let me build in private forever, waiting for it to be ready
- [explore] don't let me keep opening new threads while nothing is finished

You do this once and rarely touch it again.

2. Then you just talk to it

mentor, what's on my plate today?

Ask what's on your plate and it won't read you the whole todo list. It picks the few that serve your main goals and names the first move on one, small enough to start now.

add "ship the landing page" to my todos

Prompts without the keyword 'todo' or 'mentor' will also trigger the mentor stance. You can brain dump what's in your mind.

I want to redo the pricing page, learn Rust, call the accountant, fix the signup bug, and write that post I keep putting off

Mention something in passing and it's kept. It then files each item against your goals, gives it a priority, and merges it with the other things you started that turned out to be the same thing. Items that serve none of your goals get said out loud and put low.

3. And it speaks up on its own

It loads into every session and reads along while you do unrelated work. When what you're doing is on your own don't-let-me list, it says so, once per pattern. You can wave it off.

It also watches what's not moving. Items that keep carrying over day after day get treated as avoidance, not as a scheduling problem.

Ask for the alignment check any time instead of waiting to be noticed: /mentor:check, $mentor-check, or just asking for one.

Who it's for

Probably most useful if you have ADHD tendencies, or something near them. You fall into rabbit holes and can't climb out, you start five things and finish none. That's what I built it around.

It works best if the agent is already where your work starts (research, writing, coding, planning a video), because then it sees what you actually did, not just what you told it. If it isn't, it still works. It just runs on what you tell it.

Something it has said to me

You've been on this dot for an hour. Fiddling with your setup is on your own don't-let-me list. Which of your three goals does it serve?

I was tuning one dot in my shell prompt, the indicator that tells me whether my proxy is on. First the colour, then the size, then whether it should be hollow or filled. I knew the answer. Knowing it and having something say it out loud are different things.

Files

~/.mentor/profile.md   your goals, your reality, your don't-let-me list
~/.mentor/todos.md     the todo surface (path configurable in profile.md)

Plain markdown on your machine. Nothing is sent anywhere, and nothing is written to your CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. Uninstalling leaves no trace but those two files. Set MENTOR_HOME to relocate them. Otherwise the first existing directory wins (~/.mentor/, then ~/.claude/mentor/, then ~/.codex/mentor/), so every agent resolves to the same profile. If more than one exists, the earlier one wins and the others are ignored; set MENTOR_HOME if that's not what you want.

Using another agent?

Just give the link of this repo to your agent and ask it to figure out how to install.

I'm also building the same idea as a standalone web app: One Thing at a Time.

License

MIT

}

然后运行 ​​/mentor-init 来设置您的配置文件，并在您需要按需进行对齐检查时运行 /mentor-check 。

在我自己的使用中，Claude Code 是效果最好的地方。 Codex 和 OpenCode 都运行它，但是推动的效果取决于它们背后的模型，而且我在 Claude 的帮助下得到了更好的结果。

1. 它采访你

安装程序会询问您一些问题，一次一个，持续约十分钟。 在 Claude Code 中运行 /mentor:init，在 Codex 中运行 $mentor-init，在 OpenCode 中运行 /mentor-init。 由此得出两件事。

您的长期目标。 你实际上正在努力的方向是什么。 如果你回答含糊其辞，它就会退缩。

你的反模式。 你可靠地以自己的方式行事的方式，在你仍然诚实的时候写下来，这样当你不诚实时它可以让你坚持下去：

- [ship] don't let me build in private forever, waiting for it to be ready
- [explore] don't let me keep opening new threads while nothing is finished

你只做一次，就很少再碰它。

2. 然后你只要和它说话

mentor, what's on my plate today?

询问你的盘子里有什么，它不会为你读出整个待办事项列表。 它会选择少数几个能够满足您主要目标的目标，并命名其中的第一步，规模足够小，可以立即开始。

add "ship the landing page" to my todos

没有关键字“todo”或“导师”的提示也会触发导师姿态。 你可以把你脑子里的想法转储出来。

I want to redo the pricing page, learn Rust, call the accountant, fix the signup bug, and write that post I keep putting off

顺便提及一些事情，它就会被保留。 然后，它会根据您的目标归档每个项目，赋予其优先级，并将其与您开始的其他事情合并，结果是相同的事情。 那些对你的目标毫无帮助的事情会被大声说出来，然后被低调地对待。

3. 它自己说话

它会加载到每个会话中，并在您执行不相关的工作时一起阅读。 当你正在做的事情在你自己的“不要让我”清单上时，它会这样说，每个模式一次。 你可以挥手把它关掉。

它还会监视那些不动的东西。 日复一日持续进行的项目被视为回避，而不是日程安排问题。

随时要求进行对齐检查，而不是等待被注意到：/mentor:check、$mentor-check，或者只是要求一项。

这是给谁的

如果您有多动症倾向或类似倾向，这可能是最有用的。 你掉进兔子洞而无法爬出来，你开始了五件事却没有完成。 这就是我所围绕的。

如果代理已经在您工作开始的地方（研究、写作、编码、规划视频），效果最好，因为这样它就能看到您实际做了什么，而不仅仅是您告诉它的内容。 如果不是，它仍然有效。 它只是按照你告诉它的内容运行。

它对我说过的话

你已经在这个点上待了一个小时了。 摆弄你的设置是你自己的“不要让我”清单上的事情。 它服务于您的三个目标中的哪一个？

我正在调整 shell 提示符中的一个点，该指示器告诉我代理是否已打开。 首先是颜色，然后是尺寸，然后是空心还是填充。 我知道答案。 知道它和大声说出来是不同的事情。

Files

~/.mentor/profile.md   your goals, your reality, your don't-let-me list
~/.mentor/todos.md     the todo surface (path configurable in profile.md)

在你的机器上进行简单的降价。 没有任何内容被发送到任何地方，也没有任何内容被写入您的 CLAUDE.md 或 AGENTS.md。 卸载后除了这两个文件外不会留下任何痕迹。 设置 MENTOR_HOME 来重新定位它们。 否则，第一个现有目录获胜（〜/.mentor/，然后〜/.claude/mentor/，然后〜/.codex/mentor/），因此每个代理都会解析为相同的配置文件。 如果存在多个，则较早的获胜，其他的被忽略；如果这不是您想要的，请设置 MENTOR_HOME。

使用其他代理？

只需将此存储库的链接提供给您的代理并要求其弄清楚如何安装即可。

我还构建了与独立 Web 应用程序相同的想法：一次只做一件事。
